scope: One-off qualification of public System.Diagnostics.Process SDK primitives with one benign direct-base-Python child; not new product implementation or S/P proof
child_profile: Direct caller-supplied pinned base interpreter; isolated/no-bytecode/no-site; only stdlib time.sleep for a finite interval; no descendants, output, project import, network, environment queries or files
q0: Preflight path/type/size/digest mismatch refuses before Start; source review must prove no launch before preflight
q1: Allocate Process instance in caller-owned custody before Start; true Start and positive associated identity required before the stop measurement
q2: Finite first WaitForExit must return false for the deliberately stalled child; then exactly one Kill request; positive WaitForExit and HasExited required with exact integer ExitCode
q3: Close/Dispose only after positive child exit; no PID-only kill/reopen, reader threads or redirected-output draining
q4: Start/kill/wait failures remain UNKNOWN or failed qualification; owned instance kept strongly until exit is observed, never claim cleanup from kill return; no automatic new child/retry
q5: One bounded closed output record, no argv, local paths or original exceptions; report runtime host facts only and measured timings without absolute wallclock guarantee
q6: Qualifies this single child and host only; descendant/domain cleanup, S admission, N1-N16 and product gates remain OPEN
no_red_claim: Existing SDK qualification: these are prospective native measurement oracles, not RED for missing product source
